item.tib: stag gdong dmar po'i bsgrubs thabs dug gis spu gri
item.coloph: rig 'dzin thugs kyi dril bsgrubs (sgrub) las/ d+dzo (mkha' 'gro) stag gdong gtso 'khor kyis (gyi)/ bsgrubs (sgrub) thabs dug gi spu gri 'di/ bya sla nus pa shin tu che/ gar thod thod la ma bstan cig de thugs kyi dkyil du sbas so/ skal ldan gcig rgyud sa ma ya/ dam nyams ru tra srin po'i rigs/ de 'dra'i sde la bstan 'gyur na/ dbyings nas mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'bebs ('beb/)de bas gsang zhing sgrab mdzod cig tshe dbang rigs 'dzin thugs kyi bcud/ mkha' 'gro las la bskul ba'i phyir/ dam nyams srog gi spu gri 'di/ dmu tsha gyer med rig 'dzin gyis/ rnal 'byor mi shigs (shig) rdo rje rtsal la brgyud/ dge legs 'phel//
